summary: SMJ International Holdings Inc., a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Notice of Extraordinary General Meeting and Proxy Statement. The meeting, scheduled for September 14, 2026, proposes adopting an amended Memorandum and Articles of Association affecting Class B share conversion triggers, written resolution thresholds, and voting procedures. The board recommends a FOR vote on both proposals. This is a routine governance matter involving charter amendments, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation event is present. The filing is a standard shareholder meeting notice with no deal terms.
